description_en: Queries the image information in an Image Search instance based on an image
description_zh: 本文为您介绍SearchByPic的语法及示例，用于根据图片查询图像搜索实例中的图片信息
name: SearchImageByPic

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, you can log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is different from the instance ID. Make sure to distinguish between them
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The image content.
The image size cannot exceed 4 MB.
Supported image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, and PPM.
The transmission timeout period cannot exceed 5 seconds.
<props="china">
If the service type is product image search, generic image search, furniture and home image search, or industrial hardware image search, the width and height of the image must be greater than or equal to 100 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
If the service type is trademark image search, the width and height of the image must be greater than or equal to 200 pixels and less than 4,096 pixels.
If the service type is fabric image search, the width and height of the image must be greater than or equal to 448 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
<props="intl">
If the service type is product image search or generic image search, the width and height of the image must be greater than or equal to 100 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
The image cannot contain rotation information.

Call the operation by using an SDK:
If you use the V3 SDK, you do not need to specify the PicContent parameter. The SDK encapsulates this parameter into the PicContentObject parameter and automatically converts it to Base64 encoding. For specific examples, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html.
The SDK does not support passing an image URL directly. The V3 SDK provides an alternative method to upload an image by using a URL. For specific examples, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html.
Call the operation by using the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI platform:
If you use the 2019-03-25 version, set the PicContent parameter to the Base64 encoded string of the image.
If you use the 2020-12-14 version, click Upload in the PicContent parameter section to upload the image
parameters.help_zh:
图片内容。
图片大小要求不超过4 MB。
图片格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WEBP、TIFF、PPM。
传输等待时间不超过5秒。
<props="china">
服务类型为商品图片搜索、通用图片搜索、家具家居图片搜索和工业五金图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100PX且小于等于4096PX。
服务类型为商标图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于200PX且小于4096PX。
服务类型为布料图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于448PX且小于等于4096PX。
</props>
<props="intl">
服务类型为商品图片搜索和通用图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100PX且小于等于4096PX。
</props>
图片中不能包含旋转信息。

使用SDK方式调用：
如使用V3版本SDK，则无需填写PicContent字段，SDK已将本字段封装为PicContentObject字段并自动转化为Base64编码。具体示例参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html。
SDK不支持客户直接传递图片URL，V3版本SDK提供了一种变相实现URL上传的方式。具体示例参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179188.html。
使用阿里云OpenAPI平台调用：
如使用2019-03-25版本，PicContent字段请填写图片的Base64编码。
如使用2020-12-14版本，在PicContent字段直接点击上传图片即可
parameters.name: pic_content

parameters.help_en:
The product category. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html.
For product image search, if you specify a category, the specified category is used. If you do not specify a category, the system predicts the category. You can obtain the predicted category from the response.
<props="china">
For fabric, trademark, generic furniture and home, and industrial hardware image search, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.
</props>
<props="intl">
For generic image search, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
商品类目。具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html。
对于商品搜索，如果设置类目，则以设置的为准；如果不设置类目，则由系统进行类目预测，预测的类目结果可以在Response中获取 。
<props="china">
对于布料、商标、通用家具家居和工业五金搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。
</props>
<props="intl">
对于通用搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。
</props>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform subject identification. Default value: true.
true: The system performs subject identification and searches for images based on the identified subject. You can obtain the subject identification result from the response.
false: The system does not perform subject identification and searches for images based on the entire image.
<props="china">
For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches for images based on the entire image.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行主体识别。默认true。
为true时，由系统进行主体识别，以识别的主体进行搜索，主体识别结果可在Response中获取。
为false时，则不进行主体识别，以整张图进行搜索。
<props="china">
对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en:
The subject region of the image. The format is x1,x2,y1,y2. x1,y1 specifies the upper-left corner, and x2,y2 specifies the lower-right corner.
If you specify the Region parameter, the system searches for images based on the specified region regardless of the value of the Crop parameter.
<props="china">
For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches for images based on the entire image.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
图片的主体区域，格式为`x1,x2,y1,y2,` 其中`x1,y1` 是左上角的点，`x2,y2`是右下角的点。
若用户设置了Region，则不论Crop参数为何值，都将以用户输入Region进行搜索。
<props="china">
对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~100。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the results to return. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition. Supported operators for int_attr include in, not in, greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), and equal to (=). Supported operators for str_attr include in, not in, equal to (=), and not equal to (!=). You can use AND and OR to connect multiple conditions.
Examples:
int_attr >= 100.
str_attr != "value1".
int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1".

The filter condition can be up to 4,096 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。int_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、大于号(>)、大于等于号(>=)、小于号(<)、小于等于号(<=)、等于号(=)。str_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、等于号(=)和不等号(!=)，多个条件之间支持AND和OR进行连接。
例如：
int_attr >= 100。
str_attr != "value1"。
int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1"。

最多支持4096个字符
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to deduplicate data based on the ProductId field during the search
parameters.help_zh: 如果为true则检索时根据ProductId字段进行去重复数据
parameters.name: distinct_product_id

parameters.help_en: The similarity score threshold. If you specify this parameter, only the images whose similarity scores are greater than or equal to the threshold are returned. Valid values: 0.00 to 1.00. The value can be accurate to two decimal places. Default value: 0.00
parameters.help_zh: 填写相似度分数阈值后，只返回图片相似度分数大于等于阈值的图片信息。阈值范围0.00-1.00，最大支持2位小数，默认为0.00
parameters.name: score_threshold

Auctions.description_en: The description information of all returned products
Auctions.description_zh: 所有返回的商品描述信息

items.description_en: The description information of all returned products
items.description_zh: 所有返回的商品描述信息

Score.description_en:
The image similarity score. Valid values: 0 to 1.
To use this field, you must upgrade the SDK to V3.1.1
Score.description_zh:
图片相似打分。取值范围：0~1。
需要版本升级至V3.1.1方可使用

SortExprValues.description_en:
The system scoring information.
[Deprecated] This field is deprecated. Use Score instead. 
SortExprValues is a semicolon-separated tuple. The first value indicates the relevance score of the image. A greater value indicates higher relevance to the queried image. This varies based on the algorithm model.
If the category is 0 to 2, the value range of SortExprValues is 0 to 7.33136443711219e+24.
If the category is other values, the value range of SortExprValues is 0 to 5.37633353624177e+24. The score reaches the maximum value when two images are exactly the same
SortExprValues.description_zh:
系统打分信息。
当前字段已弃用，建议使用Score。 
SortExprValues是一个分号分隔的二元组，第一个值表示图片的相关性分数，值越大表示和查询的图片相关性越高。由于算法模型不同。
当类目为0~2时，SortExprValues值域范围：0～7.33136443711219e+24。
类目为其他值时，SortExprValues值域范围：0～5.37633353624177e+24。当两个图片完全一样时，这个分值最大

Code.description_en:
The error code.
0: Success.
Non-zero values: Failure
Code.description_zh:
错误码。
0：成功。
非0：失败

Head.description_en: The overview of the search results

DocsFound.description_en: The total number of returned results

DocsReturn.description_en: The number of matched results in the instance

PicInfo.description_en: The information such as the category prediction and subject identification results
PicInfo.description_zh: 类目预测、主体识别结果等信息

AllCategories.description_en: All category information supported by the system
AllCategories.description_zh: 系统支持的所有类目信息

items.description_en: All category information supported by the system
items.description_zh: 系统支持的所有类目信息

CategoryId.description_en: The category prediction result. If a category is specified in the request, the specified category is used
CategoryId.description_zh: 类目预测结果。若用户请求中指定了类目，则以请求中为准

MultiRegion.description_en:
The collection of subject identification results.
To use this field, you must upgrade the SDK to V3.1.1
MultiRegion.description_zh:
主体识别结果集合。
需要版本升级至V3.1.1方可使用

Region.description_en: The subject identification result. The subject region of the image. The format is x1,x2,y1,y2. x1,y1 specifies the upper-left corner, and x2,y2 specifies the lower-right corner. If a subject region is specified in the request, the specified region is used
Region.description_zh: 主体识别结果。图片的主体区域，格式为x1,x2,y1,y2，其中 x1,y1 是左上角的点，x2，y2是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

Region.description_en: The subject identification result. The subject region of the image. The format is x1,x2,y1,y2. x1,y1 specifies the upper-left corner, and x2,y2 specifies the lower-right corner. If a subject region is specified in the request, the specified region is used
Region.description_zh: 主体识别结果。图片的主体区域，格式为x1,x2,y1,y2，其中 x1,y1 是左上角的点，x2，y2是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
